name: Linear
blurb: Issues and projects. One sign-in, reused by context and planning sync.

token.label: Personal API key
token.help: In Linear: Settings, Account, Security and access, Personal API keys. Create a key with Restricted access: Read and Write (not Admin), and only the team this brain syncs with. A key works in one Linear workspace, so each brain gets its own. Paste it here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
